name: twitter-gpt
description: A chrome extension that writes tweets with a local Codex helper
author: Yaroslav https://twitter.com/512x512

scripts.build:ext: bun run clean && bun build src/inject/inject.ts src/background/background.ts src/settings/settings.tsx --outdir lib --entry-naming '[name].js' --target browser --format iife --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"'
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:ext && bun run typecheck:helper
scripts.package:ext: rm -f extension.zip && bun run build:ext && rm -rf .extension-package && mkdir -p .extension-package && cp manifest.json .extension-package/ && cp -R lib assets css icons .extension-package/ && cd .extension-package && zip -r -X ../extension.zip . && cd .. && rm -rf .extension-package
